executive_summary: Agents.md and send-to-gemini.js fully satisfy the migration contract. All 13 semantic areas from the legacy evaluator definitions are canonically merged into Agents.md under Canonical Evaluation Definitions and the Governing Rule Catalog with complete definitions, definitions of evaluation, and pass/fail criteria. All former markdown-style rules have been converted into key:value catalog rules with verbose names, definitions, definitions of evaluation, pass/fail criteria, and at least three rule-following and three rule-breaking scenario examples citing criterion_used and status. Each step (Steps 0 through 4) contains an explicit evaluation_requirements list and is preceded by a JSON field definition glossary covering every field of that step's execution return and supervisory gate with key, value, definition, definition_of_evaluation, pass_criteria, and fail_criteria. A procedure dependency chart maps concrete procedure values to decisions, downstream storage artifacts, and source code consumers. All requirements to read external evaluator-definitions.md and all read-tracking keys (evaluation_documents_read) have been completely eliminated from both Agents.md and send-to-gemini.js, while Step 3 retains access to evaluation-tests.md as its test corpus. Deterministic schema validation in send-to-gemini.js strictly matches the canonical Step 0-4 return schemas and supervisory envelope, and supervisory gating correctly enforces same-step retry on FAIL and advancement only on PASS.

program_reference.behavior: gateValue extracts supervisory_gate.gate_result ('PASS' or 'FAIL'). On PASS, advances current_step to the next uncompleted step and clears failure state; on FAIL, maintains current_step on the same step and records last_supervisory_failure.

requirement_evaluations.explanation: The transition key supervisory_gate.gate_result is strictly evaluated against {'PASS', 'FAIL'}. On FAIL, send-to-gemini.js sets current_step = step (lines 788-798), forcing ChatGPT to repeat the same step. On PASS, current_step advances exactly one step (lines 779-787). The run terminates with status 'complete' only when remaining_steps is empty after Step 4 passes.

transition_evaluation.explanation: The supervisory handoff, unevaluated template generation via gateTemplate, granular evaluation shape enforcement via evalShape, missing/malformed repair loop via supervise (lines 636-688), same-step restart on FAIL, and single-step advance on PASS operate strictly according to the canonical specification.
